question: Will UODO publish an announcement specifically about the FELG Dent breach by October 16, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: high-profile Polish medical-data breaches in 2026 under UODO head Wróblewski (MyDr, Medyc). UODO published dedicated news items naming the company each time, the Medyc one within a day of press coverage. FELG went public around 1 October, but as of 5 October UODO's news page has nothing naming FELG, even though UODO posted other items on 1 and 5 October. That silence suggests a deliberate wait or a choice not to name FELG. For YES: the breach is large (2.4M records claimed), and FELG's controversial request that clinics not report to UODO is a natural trigger for a UODO statement. For NO: UODO may avoid naming a processor or speak only through the media. No human prediction market found.
calls.dossier:
- UODO Aktualności (uodo.gov.pl/pl/138), checked 2026-10-05: newest items are 05.10 (fine for not complying with a UODO decision), 01.10 (UODO/ZUS seminar), 30.09 (UODO intervention on pharmacy systems), 29.09 (Chinese platform data leak, referral to Prosecutor General), 25.09 (Medyc leak, inspection announced). None names FELG, FELG Dent or Fakturownia.
- Precedent MyDr: UODO item 'Prezes UODO skontroluje spółkę MyDr' on 13.08.2026 and a Q&A item on 27.08.2026, both naming the company.
- Precedent Medyc: press (CyberDefence24, Zaufana Trzecia Strona) reported it on Thu 24.09.2026; UODO item naming Qbusoft published 25.09.2026 (uodo.gov.pl/pl/138/4585). On 16.09 UODO announced broader health-sector inspections through end-2026.
- FELG: incident detected around 28.09; FELG notified clients 01.10 at 17:17 CEST; said it notified the prosecutor and contacted UODO (cyberscope.pl 01.10; bankier.pl 02.10). Group 'Horus' claims 2.4M patient records and demands 100k PLN; FELG says about 10% of its database was taken.
- FELG publicly asked clinics to hold off reporting breaches to UODO until it confirms which clinics were affected. Commentators note clinics are the controllers and have a 72h duty to report. Searched for a UODO response to this appeal: none found as of 05.10.
- Media articles (bankier 02.10, cyberscope 01.10) contain no UODO quote or statement on FELG.
- Status quo: no UODO news item naming FELG.
- Resolves off the UODO news section only, not media coverage, social media posts or the breach register; the item must name FELG.
- Event window: items dated 2026-01-01 through 2026-10-15 23:59 UTC qualify. FELG became public about 01.10, so the effective window is 01.10 to 15.10; as of 05.10 09:30 UTC about 29% of that has elapsed and 10.6 days remain.
- Prediction markets (Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi): none found.
- Not found: any UODO spokesperson comment on FELG; any UODO X/LinkedIn post naming FELG.
calls.reference_class: Major 2026 Polish health-sector breaches covered in national media, and whether UODO published a news item naming the firm within about 2 weeks

calls.reasoning: UODO has been very active on the 2026 wave of medical-data breaches. For MyDr it posted a Q&A, and for Medyc it published within days and announced an inspection of Qbusoft. FELG's advice to practices to hold off reporting breaches to UODO is the kind of thing UODO typically answers in public. Against that, 4 days after the 1 October disclosure UODO has posted 3 unrelated items (30 Sept–5 Oct) and nothing naming FELG, and it hasn't named Fakturownia either. So it is being selective, or waiting. With 11 days left, I land a little under even. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.

- UODO news list as fetched 5 Oct 2026, latest first: 05.10 penalty for not complying with a UODO decision; 01.10 UODO/ZUS seminar report; 30.09 UODO President intervenes on personal data in pharmacy systems; 30.09 failing to give access to data may bring penalties; 29.09 Chinese-platform data leak, UODO intervenes with the Prosecutor General; 29.09 tax office vs privacy; 25.09 'Miliony Polaków poszkodowane' (medical breach / Medyc). - FELG timeline: detected ~28 Sep, clients notified 1 Oct, prosecutor and UODO contacted. Attackers ('Horus') claim 2.4M patient records and ask 100k PLN ransom; FELG estimates ~2M records (cyberscope 1 Oct, alertmedyczny 2 Oct, spidersweb 2 Oct).

calls.reasoning: UODO quickly named prior medical-sector incidents in its news section: MyDr (Aug 12 statement plus inspection) and Medyc/Qbusoft (a statement on Sep 25, one day after the leak went public). FELG's advice that clinics not report the breach is a natural trigger for a UODO statement. Against that: FELG went public Oct 1, and as of Oct 5 the UODO news list (items dated Oct 1 and Oct 5) has nothing on FELG, a slower response than for Medyc. UODO may also be avoiding a per-incident statement during a wave of leaks, or may fold FELG into general sector messaging without naming it. About 10.6 days remain and UODO posts roughly one item a day. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.

calls.reasoning: Reference class: 2026 high-profile Polish medical-platform breaches (MyDr, Medyc/Qbusoft). UODO published a news item naming the company in both cases, the Medyc one within about a day. FELG's advice that clinics delay reporting to UODO is a strong trigger, since it echoes UODO's MyDr guidance that controllers must report breaches at their processors. But four days after the 1 Oct disclosure UODO has posted unrelated items and nothing on FELG or Fakturownia. That suggests slower or more selective handling than with Medyc, so the remaining ~10.6 days carry a declining hazard. The breach is also smaller (2.4M claimed vs 5M/19M). No human prediction market found.
calls.reconciliation: No factual conflicts. All runs agree the UODO news list (items 25.09–05.10) contains no FELG mention as of 5 Oct, that MyDr and Medyc were named quickly, and that FELG asked clinics not to report yet. The only difference is judgment: how much weight UODO's four-day silence deserves against the strong trigger. Medyc was named within about a day, so the silence on FELG is informative and pushes the hazard down. I land slightly below the runs at 0.38. I retrieved nothing myself on this run.
